# Charj Legal

Privacy Policy & Terms of Service for the [Charj](https://github.com/alabenkhlifa/CharJ) mobile app.

**This repo is generated.** Do not edit the HTML by hand.
Source markdown lives in [`CharJ/charj/docs/PRIVACY.*.md`](https://github.com/alabenkhlifa/CharJ/tree/main/charj/docs) and `TERMS.*.md`.
Regenerate via `python3 scripts/build-legal-site.py` from the app repo, then
commit and push here.

## Live pages

GitHub Pages serves this repo at https://alabenkhlifa.github.io/CharJ-Terms/

- Landing: `index.html`
- Privacy Policy: `privacy-en.html` · `privacy-fr.html` · `privacy-ar.html`
- Terms of Service: `terms-en.html` · `terms-fr.html` · `terms-ar.html`
